lines.text: Jesus says His coming will be like the days of Abraham, when people were oblivious until the flood came.
The master puts the faithful servant in charge of all his possessions when he finds him feeding the household.
The wicked servant says his master will be away a long time, but the master comes on a day he expects.

wrong_details.true: a day he does not expect
